title: English Practice Quiz 0914
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: I think it ___ tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Will plus the base verb can express a future prediction.

questions.question: I saw ___ elephant at the zoo.
questions.explanation: Use an before a vowel sound.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
options: Because I was tired, I went to bed early.
Because I tired, went bed early.
I because was tired bed early.
Because tired I went early bed.
questions.explanation: The subordinate clause beginning with because explains the reason.

questions.question: Read: 'Please keep the floor dry to prevent accidents.' What is the instruction?
questions.explanation: The notice instructs people to keep the floor dry.

questions.question: The weather can ___ your travel plans.
questions.explanation: Affect is usually a verb meaning to influence.

questions.question: She said, 'Please sit down.'
options: She asked me to sit down.
questions.explanation: A request can be reported with asked + object + to-infinitive.

questions.question: She ___ to work every day.
questions.explanation: With he, she or it in the present simple, add -s or -es to most verbs.

questions.question: I ___ him last week.
questions.explanation: Use the past simple with a finished past time such as last week.

questions.question: Mount Everest is ___ highest mountain in the world.
You did not hear someone. You say:
questions.explanation: Could you repeat that, please? is a polite request.
